summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Supermax
film.announcement: Jason Clarke joins the action-thriller as a cast member. The film is in development at Amazon MGM Studios and Miramax.

film.title: Spring Breakers 2
film.announcement: Bella Thorne is set to write, direct, and star in the sequel after producers saw her directorial debut.

film.title: Toxic
film.announcement: Trailer released for the gangster epic featuring Yash in a dual father-son role exploring conflict at the core of the story.

tv.title: Boston Blue
tv.announcement: Will Estes, alum from 'Blue Bloods,' is reprising his role on the series.

tv.title: Tucci in Italy
tv.announcement: The Emmy-nominated series is moving from Italy to the United Kingdom for its next season.
